name: Fire Sale
description: Buy any one face-up market stock for a flat $3, regardless of its listed price. Not a normal buy: no price move, no special ability triggers.

name: First Look
description: Draw the top card of the market deck into your hand.

name: Foresight
description: Look at the top 4 cards of the event deck. Put them back on top in any order; optionally, move one of the 4 to the bottom of the deck instead of keeping all 4 on top. No card leaves the game either way.

name: Market Panic
description: Every other player loses $3. A player with less than $3 just drops to $0 -- this does not trigger a loan.

name: Backroom Deal
description: Trade any one card from your hand -- a stock, action card, market-movement card, or even a private goal -- for any one face-up market card. Your card goes face-up into that market slot and is auctioned normally later. Taking the market card this way is a plain swap: no price move, no special ability triggers. This exposes the traded card's identity to the whole table, even if it was a private goal.

name: Double Down
description: Pay $2 to the bank (this can trigger a loan if you can't cover it) -- then choose a different single-use action card in your hand, resolve its effect twice, and discard it. Cannot target a persistent card or any hidden end-game bonus card.

name: Nest Egg
description: Never played -- stays secret in your hand all game. Worth a flat +$7 at final wealth calculation.

name: Portfolio
description: Never played -- stays secret in your hand all game. +$2 at game end for every stock card you hold (Wild Shares count).

name: Trophy Case
description: Never played -- stays secret in your hand all game. +$3 at game end for every goal you've completed (public or private claims both count; an unclaimed private goal does not).

name: Clean Ledger
description: Never played -- stays secret in your hand all game. +$10 at game end if you took zero loans the entire game.

name: Easy Credit
description: Never played -- stays secret in your hand all game. Every loan you took costs a flat -$10 at game end instead of the normal -$12 / -$14.
